criteria.title: Identifier search shows correct match count for fixtures
criteria.blocker: Phone identifier search requires exact match (not partial search). Fixture patients have unique phone numbers, so cannot demonstrate plural count ('N results' where N > 1). Partial searches like '+91', '+916', '918' return 0 results. Only full exact phone (e.g. '+916186172164') returns 1 match. Name identifier supports partial search and could demonstrate feature (e.g. 'ma' → 5 results), but changes identifier type tested.
